name: io.github.arbonomous/curvecall
title: CurveCall
description: Paid token market data, risk signals and trade simulations for AI agents. USDC via x402.

tools.name: quote_buy
tools.description: Bonding-curve BUY quote (constant product, virtual reserves). $0.001 USDC.

quote_reserves.description: Positive virtual reserve amount of the quote asset in consistent human-readable asset units, not USD unless the quote asset is USD-denominated.

token_reserves.description: Positive virtual token reserve amount in human-readable token units, consistent with the amount supplied.

amount_in.description: Positive amount of quote asset to spend in the simulation, in the same units as quote_reserves. No trade is executed.

fee_bps.description: Simulated trading fee in basis points; 100 means 1 percent. Curve simulation requires at least 0 and less than 10000. This is not the CurveCall API charge.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: quote_sell
tools.description: Bonding-curve SELL quote (constant product, virtual reserves). $0.001 USDC.

quote_reserves.description: Positive virtual reserve amount of the quote asset in consistent human-readable asset units, not USD unless the quote asset is USD-denominated.

token_reserves.description: Positive virtual token reserve amount in human-readable token units, consistent with the amount supplied.

amount_in.description: Positive token amount to sell in the simulation, in the same units as token_reserves. No trade is executed.

fee_bps.description: Simulated trading fee in basis points; 100 means 1 percent. Curve simulation requires at least 0 and less than 10000. This is not the CurveCall API charge.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description:
START HERE before buying a token. One call returns a buy / watch / avoid
decision with the reasons, risk score, key numbers (price, liquidity, volume,
age) and heuristic sizing and stop distance. $0.01 USDC. For full raw data
use precheck. Heuristic screen, not financial advice.

chain.description: Lowercase chain identifier used by the data provider, for example base, ethereum or solana. Coverage varies by tool and upstream data availability.

address.description: Public token contract address on the selected chain. EVM addresses use 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters; Solana uses its base58 mint address.

amount_usd.description: Optional positive USD trade budget used only for heuristic sizing, not for executing a trade or authorizing the API payment.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: precheck
tools.description:
Pre-trade bundle: snapshot + risk screen + curve trade simulation in ONE
call. Tells you what your buy will do - quote, slippage, rug-risk verdict.
$0.01 USDC. No other x402 service sells trade simulation.

chain.description: Lowercase chain identifier used by the data provider, for example base, ethereum or solana. Coverage varies by tool and upstream data availability.

address.description: Public token contract address on the selected chain. EVM addresses use 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters; Solana uses its base58 mint address.

side.description: Simulation direction: buy spends quote asset to receive tokens; sell spends tokens to receive quote asset. Must be buy or sell.

amount_in.description: Optional positive simulated trade input: quote-asset units for buy, token units for sell. Omit to skip simulation. No trade is executed.

fee_bps.description: Simulated trading fee in basis points; 100 means 1 percent. Curve simulation requires at least 0 and less than 10000. This is not the CurveCall API charge.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: deployer_history
tools.description:
Deployer launch history from CurveCall's hourly launch-outcome index on
Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc (built since 2026-09-24): every launch this
deployer made and how it ended (survived, rugged, died), with rug rate and
dev-behavior flags (dev moved tokens, relaunch count). Answers 'has this
deployer rugged before?' $0.01 USDC. Data by GeckoTerminal.

chain.description: Indexed chain: base, robinhood or arc. History begins September 24, 2026 and is not complete chain history.

address.description: Public deployer wallet address, 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters, whose indexed launch history is requested.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: bundle_check
tools.description:
Bundle/sniper signals for a token (base, bsc, robinhood, arc): who bought
in the first blocks after launch, how much of the early supply they took,
and whether any were funded by the deployer or a shared wallet. Signals,
not advice. Elysium returns verified holder concentration and transfer
clustering only, not verified buys or insider attribution. $0.02 USDC.
Data by GeckoTerminal; Elysium uses its public RPC.

chain.description: Supported chain: base, bsc, robinhood, arc or elysium. Elysium returns holder concentration and transfer clustering, not verified purchases or insider attribution.

address.description: Public token contract address on the selected chain. EVM addresses use 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters; Solana uses its base58 mint address.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description:
Search tokens by name, symbol or contract address across chains.
$0.005 USDC.

q.description: Non-empty token name, symbol or public contract address to search for.

chain.description: Optional lowercase chain identifier to filter results, for example base or solana. Omit to search across chains.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results, from 1 to 25; default 10.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.
